**Behavior implemented**
- Home hero: desktop `7fr/3fr`; main manual 3-slide carousel (~70%) with one whole-slide `<a>` per slide, an `h1` title and a single CTA `<span class="btn btn-primary hero-cta">` (no nested anchor/button), controls separate; no "All products" hero CTA (header/nav "All products" kept). Right column: two equal Northgate/Larkhill brand promo cards, height-matched on desktop, two equal columns ≤900px, no autoplay, hidden slides excluded from display/focus.
- Final section before footer: three latest published articles (desc `publishedAt`, stable slug tie, drafts excluded), each with local `articleArt`, `<time datetime>` en-GB date, title, body start clamped to 4 lines, linking to `#journal?slug=`. Zero published hides the section; fewer show available without duplicates.
- Safe legacy migration: adds only missing article fixtures and fills only missing metadata (`publishedAt`/`artVariant`/`excerpt`); never overwrites edited title/body/published, orders, cart, wishlist. `winter-commute` stays unpublished; body used in previews, not excerpt.
- Browser corrections folded in: real `h1` in hero (`.hero-copy` now a `div`), clamp bleed moved off `.article-preview` with `max-height: calc(4*1.5em)`, `.latest-card` de-underlined with neutral border/radius + hover/focus (scoped, journal list untouched), stronger hero/promo overlay (`0.72/0.45/0.40`) for white-text legibility.

**Changed files**
- `prototype/fixtures.mjs`, `prototype/domain.mjs`, `prototype/assets.mjs`, `prototype/storefront.mjs`, `prototype/styles.css`, `prototype/check.mjs`, `docs/prototype.md`, `docs/ai/tasks/bike-store-home-promotions/deviations.md`
- `docs/THESAURUS.md` (parent's `Article` addition) left unmodified.

- `node --check prototype/app.mjs` / `domain.mjs` / `storefront.mjs` → exit 0 each.

**Blockers**: none. **Unverified by me**: real browser acceptance (proportions/equality/no-overflow/mobile legibility) — Sol owns it. No commit/push, no OpenSpec archive, no subdelegation.
